results.title: All-round India beat Zimbabwe in 2nd T20I: Stats
results.description: Team India has won the second Women's T20I against Zimbabwe by a whopping nine wickets.

results.title: India News | “Symbol of Victory of Good over Evil”: Himachal Pradesh CM on Kullu Dussehra Organised in Canada
results.description: Get latest articles and stories on India at LatestLY. Himachal Pradesh Chief Minister Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu virtually addressed an event organised to mark the grand celebration of the world-renowned Kullu Dussehra at Parliament Hill in Ottawa, Canada.
